verdict.text: Rwanda pledges a 16% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (unconditional), and 38% conditional. The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-12-08. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (2020). The document's condition, in its own words: "The combined unconditional and conditional contribution is therefore a 38 per cent reduction in GHG emissions compared to BAU in 2030; this is equivalent to an estimated mitigation level of up to 4.6 million tCO2e in 2030." 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 13.5 MtCO₂e, DS-35 9.7 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 16% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 40.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Emission reductions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario, not quantified reduction target mentioned. It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.09°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.99°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
